A '''multisegmented worm''' was a creature that lived on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. They could grow up to a [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]] in length.<ref name="conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>
